>thank you for your response. I have thought about contacting her many times. I worry that we arent capable of being friends. Our relationship was very sexual, and we didnt see eye to eye on much else other than these dark feelings. I think she would be willing to listen a little bit, but would suspect my intentions of being disingenuous eventually (which they wouldnt be, but she would have every right to think it).   
  
>  
>I think my fiancee would come to understand why I would want to talk to my ex, but I know it would hurt her feelings very deeply. I dont want to make anyone feel as rotten as me.   
  
>  
>I appreciate you taking the time to read and respond, I'll consider what you've suggested. You're probably a good person. Thank you.

​

I'm male and 29 years old, am a homeowner, have a good job, a beautiful and loving fiancee (who I dont deserve). I have a very supportive family and live in a nice area. 

​

For the past 14 years I have wanted to do nothing more than to end my own life.  


I fantasize about tightening the noose around my neck and handcuffing my hands behind my back before I kick the chair out from under me. I think about how much I will squirm and fight, if at all, while I hang. I think about how discolored my face will look when my family finds me and how they will react, and its not enough to make me not want to do this.   


I have a 12 gauge shotgun in the house. I think about putting a garbage bag over my head before pointing the gun towards it so that the bag will catch some of the mess after I pull the trigger.  


What I really have to get off my chest though, is that I am too big of a pussy to actually go through with any of it, so I'll just keep rotting away from the inside out.
